stories.title: Game Recap — Brewers 4, Cubs 3 — Late Lead Slips
stories.angle: Cubs led 2-1 through seven innings but bullpen surrendered two 8th-inning runs. Ramírez solo HR, Bregman go-ahead RBI. Late-lead collapse in Milwaukee.

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Ramírez with the solo shot. Bregman with the go-ahead RBI in the 7th.

Cubs had the lead. Brewers walked it back in the 8th. Final: 4-3 Milwaukee.

Peterson vs Misiorowski tonight, 6:40 PM CT. Series needs a win.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.angle: Misiorowski (14-5, 1.97 ERA, NL Cy Young favorite) vs Peterson (7-8, 5.39 ERA). Cubs knocked Miz around for 5 runs in 4 IP at Wrigley last week. Can they do it again?

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Watch — One of the Greatest Seasons in Cubs History
stories.angle: 40 HR / 33 SB. Needs 7 more steals for the 40-40 club (only 6 players in MLB history). No Cub has ever done it. 17 games to get there.

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong: 40 HR / 33 SB.

Seven stolen bases from the 40-40 club. Six players in MLB history have ever done it. No Cub has ever done it.

17 games to get there.

stories.title: Matt Shaw Returns — Roster Depth Just In Time
stories.angle: Shaw activated after hand strain (out since June 29). Hit .316 in 5 Iowa rehab games. Returns to fill 2B with Swanson still on oblique IL.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
Matt Shaw: .316 in 5 Iowa rehab games. 6 hits. 4 RBI. Back in Chicago.

With Swanson's oblique keeping him sidelined, Shaw returns at EXACTLY the right time. Playoff roster depth activated.

stories.title: Wild Card Standings — Cubs WC1, But Race Is Tight
stories.angle: Cubs 81-64 NL WC1 with Phillies right behind. Every win in this Brewers series matters for seeding. Making September hard by losing to the division leader.

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
Cubs: 81-64, NL WC1 — for now.

The Phillies are right there. Every game in this Brewers series is a playoff game.

Win tonight. Win tomorrow. Don't make September harder than it has to be.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Jaxon Wiggins Is Making His October Case
stories.angle: 4 straight scoreless Iowa bullpen outings. 7 K in 16 BF. Cubs need bullpen depth for October. The argument for calling him up is getting harder to ignore.

x_posts.label: Post 6A
x_posts.text:
Jaxon Wiggins: 4 straight scoreless outings out of Iowa's bullpen. 7 strikeouts in 16 batters faced.

The Cubs need October arms. Wiggins is making his case louder every time out.

Call him up. Now.
